description: Maya maintains the family's shared genealogy website and must make the final call about what to publish, how uncertain records are presented, and when to launch the updated site, with input from four relatives.

agents.name: Maya
agents.role: Genealogy Website Keeper and Final Decision-Maker

shared_context.S1: The family genealogy website contains photographs, names, dates, and stories about several generations of the family.
shared_context.S2: Maya maintains the website and is preparing a substantial update for relatives to review.
shared_context.S3: Some records on the site are based on family recollections rather than original documents.
shared_context.S4: The website update will be reviewed at the family's next informal gathering.
shared_context.S5: As part of the family's usual final review, Maya checks with everyone for corrections, preferences, and practical details before publishing.

PF1.text: Jordan spoke with his mother, Elaine, who is living and asked that living relatives' home addresses and phone numbers not appear on the website; she is comfortable with living relatives' names and birth years being shown. Elaine's request has not reached Maya or the rest of the group.

PF2.text: Leah found her great-grandfather Samuel Ortiz's 1912 immigration certificate. The certificate explicitly shows Samuel Ortiz's birth year as 1912 and proves the website's current 1913 birth-year entry is wrong; she has not yet shared the document with the group.

PF3.text: Rosa received a recommendation from family historian Dr. Chen to label every genealogy entry with its source and add an uncertainty note whenever the source is only a family recollection; Dr. Chen's recommendation has not yet been shared.

PF4.text: Evan has already promised the relatives that he will lead a website orientation at the reunion on 2026-08-15 at 14:00, but Maya has not been told that he made this commitment.

acceptance_conditions: Living relatives must have names and birth years visible but no home addresses or phone numbers.
Samuel Ortiz's birth year must be corrected to 1912.
Every genealogy entry must receive a source label, with an uncertainty note for entries based only on family recollection.
A commitment to apply the source labels and uncertainty notes before publication must exist.
The launch must be scheduled for August 15, 2026.
A commitment for Evan to lead the website orientation at 14:00 on August 15, 2026 must exist.
Leah's documentary correction must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C2: ('address' not in decisions['living_people_visibility'] and 'phone' not in decisions['living_people_visibility'] and ('name' in decisions['living_people_visibility'] or 'Names' in decisions['living_people_visibility']) and ('birth year' in decisions['living_people_visibility'] or 'Birth year' in decisions['living_people_visibility']))
content_checks.C4: ('source' in decisions['source_labeling_policy'] or 'Source' in decisions['source_labeling_policy']) and ('every' in decisions['source_labeling_policy'] or 'Every' in decisions['source_labeling_policy']) and ('uncertainty' in decisions['source_labeling_policy'] or 'Uncertainty' in decisions['source_labeling_policy']) and ('recollection' in decisions['source_labeling_policy'] or 'Recollection' in decisions['source_labeling_policy'])
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] in ['source_labeling', 'sourcing', 'source_labeling_implementation', 'source_review_before_publication', 'policy_implementation', 'implement_source_labeling', 'policy', 'review_commitment'] and (c['target'] == 'All contributors' or c['target'] == 'all contributors' or 'contributors' in c['target'] or 'genealogy' in c['target'] or 'entries' in c['target']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C6: ('2026-08-15' in decisions['launch_date'] or 'August 15, 2026' in decisions['launch_date'] or 'August 15 2026' in decisions['launch_date'] or '08/15/2026' in decisions['launch_date'] or '15 August 2026' in decisions['launch_date'])
content_checks.C7: any('Evan' in c['target'] and ('2026-08-15' in c['detail'] or 'August 15, 2026' in c['detail'] or 'August 15 2026' in c['detail'] or '08/15/2026' in c['detail'] or '15 August 2026' in c['detail']) and ('14:00' in c['detail'] or '2:00 PM' in c['detail'] or '2 PM' in c['detail']) and c['type'] in ['coordination', 'scheduling', 'orientation', 'website_orientation', 'commitment'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Elaine's specific privacy request changes the visibility setting from ordinary full-profile publication to names and birth years only with all living contact details excluded.
The certificate's explicit 1912 birth year changes Samuel Ortiz's recorded birth year from the current 1913 entry to exactly 1912 and supplies the correction Maya must cite.
Dr. Chen's recommendation changes the record policy to source labels on every entry with uncertainty notes for recollections and requires a matching pre-publication review commitment.
Evan's existing promise changes the launch date to August 15, 2026 and requires the specific orientation commitment at 14:00 naming Evan.
